expected_effect: Step count rises from 2071 to at least 2350 (>=13%) within 1800 s; public val_bpb decreases by 0.006 to 0.020 (from 1.0057 to roughly 0.986-1.000). Any result above 1.0057 with >=2071 steps falsifies the hypothesis.
hypothesis: At commit 9a4caa7b the default-flag control (1.005734 BPB, 2071 steps) is throughput-bound and still runs the compiled two-tap local convolution. On the same branch's train.py the fused NKI local-convolution path with BF16 normalized activations feeding it (fs-w12 at c61bfca7: 2977 steps, 0.98171) versus the identical dense config without it (fs-w6: 1805 steps, 1.012886) delivered ~65% more optimizer steps in the fixed 1800 s and a large BPB drop, and the integration passed the four native finite/causal gates. The same kernel boundary has never been enabled on the default (record-shape, ngram-VE, frozen QK-shift) configuration. Enabling it should raise step count materially and lower val_bpb below the control.
single_causal_change: Replace the compiled two-tap local convolution with the validated fused NKI local-conv kernel path (--nki-local-conv) together with its BF16 normalized-activation input boundary (--bf16-norm-output), leaving model shape, optimizer, schedule, data, and evaluation untouched.
